name: London Zoo
description: Explore one of the world’s oldest zoos, home to over 750 incredible species. From immersive habitats to interactive exhibits, it offers an unforgettable day out for visitors of all ages.

name: Bus Tour
description: Discover London’s iconic landmarks in comfort with a hop-on, hop-off bus tour. Enjoy guided routes, scenic views, and included walking tours, plus a relaxing Thames river cruise.

name: London Eye
description: Take in breathtaking panoramic views of the city from one of London’s most famous attractions. The London Eye offers a unique perspective, giving you a stunning look at the capital from above.

name: Aquarium
description: Step into an enchanting underwater world filled with fascinating marine life. Walk through immersive tunnels and get up close to a wide variety of sea creatures in this captivating experience.

name: Museum
description: Discover the rich history of Britain through fascinating exhibits and artifacts. Explore stories of the past and connect with the people and events that shaped the nation.
